exposure: Mode of becoming pregnant (medically assisted reproduction vs. unassisted pregnancies)
Type of medically assisted reproduction treatments (fertility-enhancing drugs, intrauterine insemination (IUI), assisted reproductive technology (ART) with autologous oocytes, ART with donor oocytes)
outcome: Maternal morbidity (blood transfusion, unplanned operating room procedure, admission to intensive care unit, eclampsia, unplanned hysterectomy, ruptured uterus)
cohort: The study included 469,919 deliveries from the birthing population in Utah between 2009 and 2017, of which 22,543 pregnancies occurred through medically assisted reproduction.
finding: More invasive medically assisted reproduction treatments (ART and IUI) are associated with higher odds of maternal morbidity, an association partially explained by multifetal gestation and obstetric comorbidities, but ART with autologous oocytes maintained a persistent association.
